result.title: These CEOs have a climate message for leaders at COP31
result.description:
More than 100 CEOs have published an open letter ahead of November’s #COP31 meeting in Antalya, Türkiye.

The Alliance of CEO Climate Leaders has a clear message: the low-carbon transition is a strategic economic opportunity.

They are asking policy-makers for faster delivery, supported by stable, predictable and climate-science-aligned policy frameworks that unlock innovation, investment and market growth.

In this video, Alliance members explain why they felt compelled to take action - including Ester Baiget of Novonesis, Juvencio Maeztu of Ingka Group (IKEA), Roy Jakobs of Philips and World Economic Forum Managing Director Sebastian Buckup.

result.title: Japan's New Tourism Record & Al Gore On The Climate Crisis | WEF | Stories of the Week
result.description:
This week's top stories of the week include:

00:12 - 3 experts on longer, healthier lives:
By 2050, 1 in 6 people globally will be over 65 - up from 1 in 11 in 2019. Here, three experts discuss how to ensure prosperous longer lives: Paul Gruenwald of S&P Global Ratings, Boon Heong Ng of Temasek Foundation and Bei Wu of NYU Shanghai.

02:47 - Al Gore: We will solve the climate crisis:
Twenty years ago, the film An Inconvenient Truth followed Climate Reality founder and former US vice president Al Gore in his campaign to spread the word about climate change. Here, Al Gore shares some reflections on what has changed in the past 20 years - and why he believes that humanity will ultimately triumph over this challenge.

04:38 - Japan sets a new tourism record:
Japan welcomed a record number of visitors in 2025, after large rises in 2024 and 2023. Some of Japan’s most historic sites, such as Tokyo and Mount Fuji, became overcrowded. So what did Japan do? It took measures to promote its more overlooked regions - including offering free domestic plane tickets.

result.title: 3 experts on how to make longer lives happier and healthier
result.description:
By 2050, 1 in 6 people globally will be over 65 - up from 1 in 11 in 2019.

As people live longer lives than ever before, what are the key ingredients for an old age that is meaningful, enjoyable, healthy and secure?

Here, three experts discuss how to ensure prosperous longer lives: Paul Gruenwald of S&P Global, Boon Heong Ng of Temasek Foundation and Bei Wu of NYU Shanghai.

The World Economic Forum’s Global Longevity Initiative convenes leaders across sectors, to shift from reactive care to proactive health, from retirement planning to lifelong financial resilience, and from fragmented efforts to coordinated action helping ensure that longer lives are healthier, more resilient and lived with dignity. Tap the link in our bio to learn more.

result.title: What's Driving the Gender Gap in the CEO Pipeline?
result.description:
There’s a gender gap in the CEO pipeline.

Chief Operating Officer and Chief Financial Officer are two of the most common routes to becoming a CEO. But women are less represented in these roles, narrowing the pipeline to the top job.

Women hold around a quarter of C-suite roles and a third of board seats, but only 19% of CEO positions and 5% of board chairs.

Find out what it will take to fix the pipeline - not just the headcount - in our report, Closing the Gender Gap in Senior Leadership, which draws on unique data from LinkedIn and Egon Zehnder: https://wef.ch/leadershipgendergap26
